sources.title: CartPole Implementation Details | sanepunk/RL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides detailed technical specifications for the two CartPole environment implementations in the repository. It covers the specific neural network architectures, training configurations, and implementation details for both the Simple REINFORCE and MOE (Mixture of Experts) REINFORCE variants that target the CartPole-v1 environment.
